prompt: Name an ancient Egyptian god or goddess

answers.name: Ra
answers.fact: The sun god, sailing across the sky by day.

answers.name: Osiris
answers.fact: God of the dead, murdered by his brother Set.

answers.name: Horus
answers.fact: The falcon god; the Eye of Horus is a symbol of protection.

answers.name: Set
answers.fact: God of chaos, deserts and storms.

answers.name: Thoth
answers.fact: The ibis-headed god of writing and wisdom.

answers.name: Hathor
answers.fact: Goddess of love, music and joy, often shown as a cow.

answers.name: Amun
answers.fact: Became king of the gods at Thebes.

answers.name: Sekhmet
answers.fact: A lioness goddess of war and plague.

answers.name: Ma'at
answers.fact: Goddess of truth; hearts were weighed against her feather.

answers.name: Khnum
answers.fact: A ram god who shaped people on a potter's wheel.

answers.name: Bes
answers.fact: A dwarf god who protected households.

answers.name: Nut
answers.fact: The sky goddess, arched over the earth.

answers.name: Atum
answers.fact: The first god, who created himself.

answers.name: Mut
answers.fact: A mother goddess, wife of Amun.

answers.name: Aten
answers.fact: The sun disc worshipped by Akhenaten.

answers.name: Neith
answers.fact: A goddess of war and weaving.

answers.name: Wadjet
answers.fact: The cobra goddess of Lower Egypt.

answers.name: Nekhbet
answers.fact: The vulture goddess of Upper Egypt.

answers.name: Khepri
answers.fact: A scarab beetle who rolls the sun.

answers.name: Ammit
answers.fact: Eats the hearts of the unworthy.

answers.name: Imhotep
answers.fact: An architect who became a god of medicine.

answers.name: Sopdet
answers.fact: The star Sirius as a goddess.

answers.name: Wepwawet
answers.fact: A wolf god, 'the opener of the ways'.

answers.name: Anhur
answers.fact: A god of war and hunting.

answers.name: Renenutet
answers.fact: A cobra goddess of the harvest.

answers.name: Meretseger
answers.fact: A cobra goddess who guarded the Valley of the Kings.

answers.name: Nefertum
answers.fact: A god of the lotus flower.

answers.name: Reshep
answers.fact: A war god borrowed from Canaan.

answers.name: Astarte
answers.fact: A goddess borrowed from the Levant.

answers.name: Hu
answers.fact: The god of the spoken word.

answers.name: Shezmu
answers.fact: A god of wine and execution.

answers.name: Pakhet
answers.fact: A lioness goddess of the hunt.

answers.name: Seker
answers.fact: A falcon god of the necropolis.

answers.name: Ihy
answers.fact: A child god who played the sistrum.

answers.name: Bennu
answers.fact: A heron bird of rebirth that may have inspired the phoenix.
